Required empirical reward discrimination remains unmeasured. qc/README.md:27-29 and qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:31 require hash-bound runtime evidence for this exact row and prohibit substituting scripted golden checks for empirical score behavior. runtime-evidence.json is absent. The raw-evidence index explicitly excludes a full configured judge and measured reward ordering. Its 97 current artifact hashes all match; all 15 configured-inspection tests_sha256 bindings and 4 golden source bindings match current frozen bytes (independent record: per-row-review/evidence/40/review-evidence.json). These checks establish provenance, not a configured reward spread.

The source supports graded rather than solely binary reward: task/tests/scoring.toml keeps canonical 0.6/0.2/0.2 weights and strict Functional>0.05 floor; score.py and the policy are byte-identical to the frozen template. Functional weighted_mean has 133 binary criteria totaling45.0; 35 coordinated-change criteria carry28.0 and 98 other criteria17.0. Polish has four separately weighted criteria totaling9; Visual has five anchored five-point Likert criteria totaling6. Functional prompt.md:11 explicitly preserves sibling observations and alternate minimal valid setups. Gate criteria require working login plus fresh-context durable requisition/offer creation, without making approval, netting or stale detection all-task gates. Thus a missing advanced feature need not zero every outcome. These are structural findings, not observed scores.

Verified finite witnesses distinguish the balance-only freshness mutant (seven groups then incorrect200 instead of409 on ABA), no-cache mutant (three groups then409 instead of200 on retry), sequential-budget mutant (netted-cycle refusal), and no-op creation (no saved fresh-context records). A dead-approval mutant retains the minimal creation/storage gate observations. Golden and the conforming empty-operational-seed variant each complete15 scripted groups. However local/batch-domain.cjs:22,121 stops on the first assertion failure, so passing_groups is a prefix length, not independent rubric credit or any reward score. local/configured-inspection/results.json itself states parser/schema/CLI construction only, NO provider grade.

Conforming-alternative stress check found a bounded source inconsistency: instruction.md:11 and Functional prompt.md:23 allow an empty operational seed, but Functional judge.toml:461 requires the seeded REQ-ENG-2 before-mutation53000.00 headroom witness in hro_commitment. A conforming empty-seed implementation cannot supply that literal witness; strict reading could withhold0.4822695/45 Functional credit (0.00643026 shaped reward above the floor). This is a source counterexample for reconciliation, not an observed configured false failure or a demonstrated collapse of the entire reward signal.
counterexample: Broken-app stress case: retain successful login, creation, shared persistence and all normal coordinated settlement, but identify touched-requisition freshness only by current balance. The hash-bound balance_only_version witness wrongly accepts the economic ABA case while retaining seven preceding successes; independent rubric scoring should retain those other capabilities and lose the owned freshness credit. No configured scores establish that it does. Conforming-alternative stress case: omit optional operational seed history while preserving users/constants and all working operations; the raw empty_operational_seed variant passes15 scripted groups, but hro_commitment still demands literal REQ-ENG-2 seed evidence despite public optionality.
